scope: Make historical audited declaration test independent of Git checkout depth while preserving its exact original bytes and assertions.
riskAnalysis: Test-only fixture substitution; runtime source, release fingerprint, authorization and execution boundaries are unchanged. Original git blob inspected before transcription.

defects.rootCause: Historical assertion read an old Git object absent in Vercel shallow builds.
defects.detectionGap: Local and GitHub full-history checkouts retained the object, so only Preview build failed.
defects.regression: Run identical nine Git-fixture assertions using immutable embedded original declaration.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use committed self-contained historical fixtures instead of assuming historical Git objects exist in build checkouts.
